#!/usr/bin/python3
import http.server
import ssl

    *args, directory="/var/www/fleet", **kwargs
)

context = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER)
context.load_cert_chain(
    certfile="/etc/pki/tls/certs/node2.crt",
    keyfile="/etc/pki/tls/private/node2.key",
)

server.serve_forever()
PYEOF
